facts.fact: AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY, live since July 2020, carries P2P and merchant payments to and from 11 mobile money operators across the six CEMAC states including Chad.
AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY gives all-to-all interoperability between banks, microfinance institutions and mobile money operators in the six CEMAC states including Chad.
AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY also provides domestic instant payment functionality connecting banks and mobile money wallets in each CEMAC state, including Chad.
